repeat.notes: The only outputs from this task are the aggregateOutputVariables.  They may be accumulated as they come in, therefore, instead of calculated after the fact.

aggregate_results.notes: The aggregates are indexed by position (0 = avg_sim, 1 = sd_sim): libsed2 does not accept the keys of aggregateOutputVariables as labels (SED2/TODO.md).
